question.text: The RBI-SEBI Standing Technical Committee on Exchange Traded Currency and Interest Rate Derivatives was constituted following a joint meeting of RBI and SEBI. On which date was this joint meeting held?

explanation.text: The Logic: A joint meeting of RBI and SEBI on February 28, 2008 decided that an RBI-SEBI Standing Technical Committee on Exchange Traded Currency and Interest Rate Derivatives would be constituted. The Trap: April 20, 2007 relates to earlier RBI guidance on OTC foreign-exchange derivatives. May 29, 2008 is the date the Standing Technical Committee submitted its report on currency futures. August 6, 2008 is the effective date of the Currency Futures (Reserve Bank) Directions, 2008. Note: Source-supported chronological sequence of the key dates: April 20, 2007 -> February 28, 2008 -> April 2008 -> May 29, 2008 -> August 6, 2008.
